description: This PHP source file defines the data transfer object (DTO) class 'LeaveEntitlementSearchFilterParams' in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It extends a base class for date range filtering and specifies parameters for filtering leave entitlement search results, including employee numbers, leave type ID, and whether the leave type is deleted.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) used for specifying filter parameters in leave entitlement search operations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting field 'entitlement.fromDate'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number as an integer or null.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns an array of employee numbers or null.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID as an integer or null.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID parameter.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the leave type is marked as deleted (boolean) or null.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Sets the leave type deleted status.
